title: Sensational Soccer
summary: Scrolling six-a-side football with physics, animated crowds, AI, and network play.
description: An original touchline-camera football game with a 960-pixel scrolling pitch, detailed procedural sprites, animated spectators, ball height and spin, tactical AI, passing, shooting, eight-voice stereo stadium music, network opposition, and a self-playing attract mode.
controls: Stick: move; A: shoot; B: pass; SELECT: demo mode
